name: 🏨 酒店前台
desc: 入住·早餐·房间·钥匙·退房·预订·停车·Wi-Fi·叫醒·行李

items.en: Welcome. May I have your name?
items.zh: 欢迎光临，请问您贵姓？

items.en: Check-in begins at three o'clock.
items.zh: 办理入住从三点开始。

items.en: Your room is on the fifth floor.
items.zh: 您的房间在五楼。

items.en: The elevator is behind you.
items.zh: 电梯就在您身后。

items.en: Here are your two room keys.
items.zh: 这是您的两张房卡。

items.en: Please sign here for me.
items.zh: 请在这里签个字。

items.en: Checkout is by eleven tomorrow.
items.zh: 退房时间是明天十一点前。

items.en: Breakfast is served in the lobby until ten.
items.zh: 早餐在大堂供应，到十点为止。

items.en: Your room is on the fifth floor, facing the garden.
items.zh: 您的房间在五楼，面朝花园。

items.en: The Wi-Fi password is printed on your key card.
items.zh: Wi-Fi 密码印在您的房卡上。

items.en: We can store your luggage behind the front desk.
items.zh: 我们可以把行李存在前台后面。

items.en: May I have a card for the deposit?
items.zh: 可以给我一张卡用作押金吗？

items.en: I've set a wake-up call for six thirty.
items.zh: 我已为您设好六点半的叫醒服务。

items.en: Parking is available in the garage across the street.
items.zh: 停车可以停在街对面的车库。

items.en: Please leave your key at the front desk whenever you go out for the day.
items.zh: 只要您外出一整天，请把钥匙留在前台。
chunks: whenever you go out for the day.

items.en: If you need a late checkout, please let us know the night before.
items.zh: 如果您需要延迟退房，请提前一晚告诉我们。
chunks: If you need a late checkout,

items.en: Guests who booked online will find their parking included in the room rate.
items.zh: 网上预订的客人会发现停车费已含在房价里。

items.en: If your room isn't ready yet, we can hold your bags until noon.
items.zh: 如果您的房间还没准备好，我们可以帮您存包到中午。
chunks: If your room isn't ready yet,

items.en: When you check out in the morning, please return both room keys to the front desk.
items.zh: 早上退房时，请把两张房卡都交回前台。
chunks: When you check out in the morning,

items.en: The suite that overlooks the harbor costs about forty dollars more for each night.
items.zh: 俯瞰港口的那间套房，每晚大约要多收四十美元。
chunks: The suite that overlooks the harbor

items.en: Because the rooftop pool is being cleaned today, it will not reopen before Friday morning.
items.zh: 因为屋顶泳池今天在清洁，它周五上午前不会重新开放。
